<!--
An apa-note reaches a float by several roads, and each road has been taken by
a different filter at one time or another: a code chunk's option, which quarto
sets on the cell div and on the float alike; a markdown image, which carries it
on the image and on the float; a fenced div; a markdown table's caption, which
quarto flattens; and a div that is not a float at all.

A successful run gives, in every format, each note exactly once, under the
float it belongs to and before whatever comes after that float.
-->

# Method

The figures and tables are @fig-chunk, @tbl-chunk, @fig-md, @fig-div and
@tbl-md.

```{r}
#| label: fig-chunk
#| fig-cap: "Zqcapchunkfig."
#| apa-note: "Zqnotechunkfig."
plot(1:3)
```

Zqafterchunkfig.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-chunk
#| tbl-cap: "Zqcapchunktbl."
#| apa-note: "Zqnotechunktbl."
knitr::kable(data.frame(a = 1:2, b = 3:4))
```

Zqafterchunktbl.
